DISCOVERY 610, DEFENDANT JESSEN HWANG'S MOTION TO COMPEL RESPONSES TO FORM AND SPECIAL INTERROGATORIES, REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS, AND REQUESTS FOR ADMISSIONS IS GRANTED IN PART. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO THE FORM AND SPECIAL INTERROGATORIES. THE MOTION IS MOOT AS TO THE REQUESTS FOR ADMISSIONS AND FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS AS RESPONSES HAVE BEEN SERVED. MONETARY SANCTIONS IN THE AMOUNT OF $900 SHALL BE PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. SEE MINUTES FOR DETAILS. JUDGE: BRUCE CHAN. NOT REPORTED.
